content:
Minol Acid and Chemicals Pvt. Ltd. is a distinguished player in the Indian chemical industry, operating from its strategically located headquarters at 102 Sudhan Apartment, Opposite Tejas School, Race Course, Baroda-7, Gujarat, India. Situated in Baroda (also known as Vadodara), a prominent industrial hub of Gujarat, Minol Acid and Chemicals Pvt. Ltd. has forged a solid reputation over the years for its unwavering commitment to quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction.

Established with the mission of delivering high-quality chemical solutions to diverse industries, the company specializes in the manufacturing, supply, and distribution of a wide array of industrial chemicals, acids, and specialty formulations tailored to meet the unique requirements of its clients. Its product portfolio serves a broad spectrum of industries, including pharmaceuticals, textiles, water treatment, agriculture, and more. By leveraging advanced technology and a team of seasoned chemical engineers, Minol Acid and Chemicals Pvt. Ltd. ensures that all its products adhere to the strictest standards of safety, quality, and environmental stewardship.

Minol Acid and Chemicals Pvt. Ltd. is also known for its customer-centric approach, offering personalized consultation, prompt delivery, and technical support to ensure that client needs are met efficiently. With its foundations deeply rooted in ethical business practices and a vision to continuously innovate, the company aims to set benchmarks in the Indian chemical sector while contributing significantly to industrial growth and sustainable development across Gujarat and beyond.
